hypotheses.C1_late_family_output_spaces_collapse: Median pairwise family-output-subspace overlap is at least 0.50 at Layer 17 and at least 0.40 above every earlier tested layer.
hypotheses.C2_late_family_input_operators_also_coll: Median pairwise overlap of rotation-invariant family input-metric top-32 spaces is at least 0.50 at Layer 17.
hypotheses.C3_leave_one_pair_out_output_specificity: The Layer-17 median correct-minus-best-wrong held-out-write projection gap is at most 0.10, while at least one earlier layer has a gap of at least 0.10.
hypotheses.C4_shared_late_coordinates_retain_family: Leave-one-pair-out nearest-centroid classification in Layer-17 global-top-four coordinate trajectories reaches at least 0.50 accuracy and permutation p at most 0.05.
hypotheses.C5_wrong_late_family_spaces_are_causally: On unseen-word edits, the best wrong-family Layer-17 output space reaches at least 0.80 pair-balanced fidelity to the correct family patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.C6_late_shared_patch_is_behaviorally_sub: The correct Layer-17 family output-4 patch reaches at least 0.70 pair-balanced fidelity to the full MLP write effect on both corpora.
hypotheses.C7_input_separation_survives_output_coll: Layer-17 median family-output overlap exceeds median family-input overlap by at least 0.30.
hypotheses.C8_late_global_coordinates_are_more_fami: Layer-17 coordinate-classification accuracy exceeds every earlier tested layer by at least 0.10.
